meta.name: pirates_vs_unicorns
meta.prompt: A pirate island and a unicorn island, at war.

character.label: war of pirate haven and unicorn sanctuary

programs.brief: A massive stranded pirate ironclad galleon turned sea fortress, bristling with tiers of heavy iron cannons pointed across the strait toward the unicorn sanctuary.
A majestic towering statue of a rearing winged unicorn with a glowing amethyst horn, projecting celestial warded crystals across the contested waters.
A heavily fortified pirate gun battery with an iron cannon aimed across the sea, powder barrels, and a tattered black flag.
A glowing quartz and amethyst obelisk humming with divine protective energy, surrounded by radiant runes etched into stone.

tokens.terrain: two distinct islands separated by a contested channel of open sea
tokens.event_direction: pirate fleet and coastal batteries targeting the unicorn sanctuary across the strait; holy defenders fortifying the opposite shore
